The ledger is kept by [[obfuscated|someone else at night.

why: The counter's third bark with its obfuscated span opened and never closed. A span is `[[<styles>|<text>]]`, and an unclosed one would otherwise reach the player as raw brackets and the rest of the line as the span's text; the engine refuses it at the document, naming the line and the character the span opens at. It declares no unit: the markup lives inside a string the schema already declares, and what the engine refuses here is markup that does not parse.
